name: Cuntswell Academy
source:
CA continues the further adventures of the main character from Sister, Sister, Sister, named and controlled by you,
as he attends college and interacts with his professors as well as his fellow classmates and their friends and family.
translation: 《康茨韦尔学院》延续了《姐妹，姐妹，姐妹》中主人公的冒险。主人公的名字和行动都由你决定；他会在大学里与教授、同学以及他们的朋友和家人互动。
